Aw… Too bad I already have such an awesome job. I bet working for Dell would be pretty cool 🙂

So, are you saying relocation may be an option? I don’t know too many senior developers, and not sure any of them would be open to relocation, but I’d be glad to pass along the information.
That’s my experience too. Great developers are already where they want to be, so it’s hard to convince them to move. Of course, all big corporations pay relocation expenses.
